TABLE.NAME: local_forumia_config
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-forum configuration for the IA assistant

FIELD.NAME: bot_userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {user}.id — the Moodle user that posts IA responses

FIELD.NAME: daily_prompt
FIELD.COMMENT: System prompt for daily summary mode

FIELD.NAME: immediate_prompt
FIELD.COMMENT: System prompt for immediate response mode

FIELD.NAME: disclaimer
FIELD.COMMENT: Disclaimer appended to every IA response

FIELD.NAME: max_requests_day
FIELD.COMMENT: Max OpenAI calls per day for this forum

FIELD.NAME: max_requests_user_day
FIELD.COMMENT: Max IA responses per user per day in this forum (0 = unlimited)

FIELD.NAME: delay_response
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = delay IA reply by 1 hour (immediate mode only)

FIELD.NAME: grading_prompt
FIELD.COMMENT: Grading criteria sent to OpenAI when the forum has whole-forum grading enabled (grade_forum > 0). Empty = grading disabled.

FIELD.NAME: inactivity_enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = AI posts a discussion starter after N days without forum activity

FIELD.NAME: inactivity_days
FIELD.COMMENT: Days without a human reply in a discussion before the AI reactivates it

FIELD.NAME: inactivity_repeat_days
FIELD.COMMENT: Minimum days between consecutive AI reactivation replies in the same discussion

FIELD.NAME: inactivity_prompt
FIELD.COMMENT: System prompt for the AI-generated inactivity reactivation reply

FIELD.NAME: inactivity_deadline
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp after which the AI stops reactivating threads. 0 = fall back to the forum due date

FIELD.NAME: last_inactivity_post
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of the last inactivity task run for this forum (observability)

TABLE.NAME: local_forumia_usage
TABLE.COMMENT: Daily usage counter per forum for rate limiting — no personal data stored
